decisions.reason: The spraying system leverages the firm's existing fluid-handling and mechanical engineering capabilities, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve it.
Low-pressure injection pumps are close to the firm's core pump expertise, enabling effective interpretation of market results and further development.
As a low-pressure pump variant, it builds on well-understood knowledge, facilitating learning from early performance and commercial adaptation.
Fire protection flow monitoring requires electronic sensing and safety-certification knowledge outside the firm's mechanical machinery base, limiting its ability to learn and improve.
